subject: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan — FintechProspect
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@fintechprospect.com>, Priya Desai <priya@fintechprospect.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan — FintechProspect

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — it was great to see the product flows and understand where you want Redwood to fit in. As promised, attached is a short proposed POC plan to make the trial successful and measurable. High-level recap and next steps below.

Demo recap
- Use case: live customer support triage + automated first-touch summarization and reranking of suggested responses.
- Key constraints: PII redaction required, on-prem option for audit logs later in project.
- Primary KPI: improve first-response resolution and reduce average handle time; secondary KPIs: latency/p95 for live responses and per-message inference cost.

Proposed POC success criteria (please confirm):
1) Quality: average human-rated answer relevance >= 4/5 on our shared test set (n=250).
2) Latency: 95th percentile latency <= 250 ms for the primary routing path (targeting 200 ms if possible).
3) Throughput: sustain 10 qps with <1% error rate in Redwood sandbox.
4) Cost: projected cost per 1M tokens under agreed threshold (we'll provide estimate during POC).

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): finalize test set, sign SOW addendum (if needed), and provision sandbox.
- Week 1: integration & ingestion of sample dataset (30–50k messages), baseline run.
- Week 2: active evaluation window (A/B vs baseline) + metric collection.
- End of Week 2: results review, decision checkpoint (expand, iterate, or stop).

Ownership
- FintechProspect: Samir (product lead) — provide sample data, success criteria sign-off, and stakeholder availability.
- Redwood: Dev Patel (SE) — sandbox provisioning and integration support; Neha Kapoor (AM) — project coordination; Rishi Malhotra (solutions) — cost/ops estimates.

Attachments: POC-plan-fintechprospect-v1.pdf (short plan + checklist).
Related links: HubSpot deal & drive link included below.

Ask: Can you confirm the success criteria above (particularly the latency target) and share a 2–3k sample of anonymized chat logs we can seed into the sandbox? Also please share 30-min slots for a kickoff call (this week preferred).

Thanks — I'll hold on scheduling until I hear availability.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
[Attachment: POC-plan-fintechprospect-v1.pdf (PDF, 73 KB)]

From: Samir Rao <samir@fintechprospect.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@fintechprospect.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan — FintechProspect

Thanks Marissa — great summary and thanks to the team for the demo. A few quick notes/questions: 

- The success criteria look good overall. Two asks from our side:
  1) Can we tighten the latency p95 target to 200 ms for the live routing path? Our live chat SLA needs to be very low-latency for the top routing tier. If 200 ms isn't feasible with the sandbox, flag it and we can discuss a dedicated test environment.
  2) We need confirmation that PII redaction will be supported in the evaluation step (we'll send anonymized logs but also want redaction available for any live traffic).

- We can provide a 3k anonymized sample by EOD Thur.
- For kickoff windows, I have availability Thu 03/05 between 9–11 PT or Fri 03/06 1–3 PT.

Looking forward to the POC.

—Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Product, FintechProspect
samir@fintechprospect.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@fintechprospect.com>, Priya Desai <priya@fintechprospect.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan — FintechProspect

Samir — thanks for the quick reply and the clarifications. We can accommodate the 200 ms p95 target as an aspiration and will surface any infra limitations during sandbox provisioning. Regarding PII redaction: yes — Redwood supports automatic token-level redaction and we'll include the configuration in the sandbox.

Updated plan (high-level changes)
- Latency target: p95 <= 200 ms (aspirational) — we will run both public sandbox and, if needed, a small dedicated instance for an apples-to-apples latency baseline.
- Privacy: enable PII redaction pipeline for the evaluation run; we will provide instructions for any required field mapping.

Internal actions (owners & ETA)
- Dev Patel: provision sandbox + deploy redaction config — ETA Thu 03/05 EOD.
- Rishi Malhotra: generate cost projection for 2-week POC + 1M token extrapolate — ETA Fri 03/06.
- Neha Kapoor: schedule kickoff and manage stakeholder invites (target Thu 03/05 9:30 PT) — ETA today.

Attached: POC-plan-fintechprospect-v2.pdf (includes the updated latency/privacy language and a short integration checklist).

Samir/Priya — if that all looks good I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 03/05 9:30 PT and Dev will share sandbox access once provisioned. Also attaching the drive link and HubSpot deal for reference.

Thanks,
Marissa
[Attachment: POC-plan-fintechprospect-v2.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)]
